initialExam.title: DFCCIL 2026 (Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation)
initialExam.conductingBody: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
initialExam.description: DFCCIL recruitment for Executive and Junior Executive positions in civil, electrical, mechanical, signal & telecom, and operations departments of the dedicated freight corridor project.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E/B.Tech in relevant engineering discipline for Executive; Diploma for Junior Executive
initialExam.qualifications: Engineering degree or diploma in relevant discipline
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, General English, Domain-specific engineering subjects.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking: 1/3rd.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Executive/Junior Executive in DFCCIL operations and maintenance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Junior Executive → Executive → Senior Executive → Manager → Senior Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit dfccil.com 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: DFCCIL pay scales (equivalent to railway pay)

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, PF, Gratuity, Railway Pass

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
